name: The Queen of Air and Darkness (Warlock)

system.description:
Ruler of the Unseelie Court. She has no face — only the dark behind it. Her Warlocks carry her cold and her silence wherever they go.

  • Dark Gift (1st): Darkness you create is impenetrable to all sight, including darkvision. You see perfectly within any darkness, magical or mundane.
  • Patron's Mark (6th): Once per day, step into a shadow within 10ft and emerge from any other shadow within 60ft as part of your movement. Requires existing shadows — distinct from Fey Step.
  • Patron Feature (12th): Once per day, wrap one creature within 60ft in Unseelie shadow for 1 minute — blinded, speed halved, all saves at disadvantage. Will save against your Class Save DC, to resist; repeat check each turn.
